about_the_game:
Siegebound – Defend, Build, and Survive the Onslaught!

🏰 A Roguelike Tower Defense Strategy Game ⚔️

Siegebound blends strategy, tower defense, and roguelike mechanics into a unique survival experience. Every siege is a test of tactical skill, adaptability, and strategic planning.

A Unique Blend of Strategy, Roguelike & Tower Defense

  • 🏰 Base Building & Expansion – Construct walls, towers, and defenses to fortify your castle.

  • ⚔️ Tactical Combat & Unit Management – Deploy and upgrade Units and Buildings that synergize together.

  • 🎲 Roguelike Progression – Level Up and spend ressources to buy powerful upgrades permanently enhancing your army or defenses.

  • 🛠️ Resource Management – Gather ressources to expand your fortress and strengthen your army.

Can You Withstand the Sieges?

With each run, no two Castles are ever the same—adapt your strategy, test new builds, and push your limits to defend against relentless Sieges.

Playtest coming soon!

Add to Wishlist now and prepare for battle!

About the Developer

Hi! I'm Matzgo, a solo indie developer working under the name Peasant Games. Siegebound is a passion project inspired by my love for strategy games like Age of Empires, Stronghold, and roguelike games like Hades. My goal was to blend strategy game elements with roguelike systems, creating a game that rewards creative builds and adaptive playstyles.

Your feedback means everything!

Let’s build, defend, and survive—together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Siegebound is a roguelike tower defense strategy game where you build and defend a castle against relentless sieges. Construct walls, deploy units, and upgrade your defenses using a roguelike progression system that makes every run unique.
